liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Listener reports goosebumps from this specific performance of the song [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-08-07.141795.sbd.pcm.streeter.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 165 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1982-08-07.165372.mtx.seamons.ht162.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 161 min [2]. Said about its sound: Initial SBD mix fluctuations left Jerry low for the first three minutes and twenty-eight seconds [2]
- **gd1982-08-07.fob.unknown.suraci.83513.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 160 min; rated 4.59/5 by 17 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds crisp and positioned right down front, possibly using Sony ECM250 microphones; Low end is muddy and loud, with bass distortion at the start of set two; Recording features actual bass presence and more depth than a more recent audience source [13][18][20]
- **gd1982-08-07.138622.beyerm201.holbrook.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 12 songs; 78 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1982-08-07.aud.ohr.92183.flac16**: audience recording; 12 songs; 85 min; rated 3.71/5 by 7 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording captures crowd reaction and clapping during the segue that soundboard lacks; Bass notes are often muddy and loud, causing distortion during the second set opening [12][19]
- **gd1982-08-07.156561.s1.beyer.tompkins.flac2448**: source not stated; 12 songs; 78 min [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls attending the entire summer tour and appreciates the band's performance of the song [10]
- Attendee describes crossing the golf course to crash the resort pool area near the venue [11]
- Reviewer asks the seeder to recall their specific seating location for the night [15]
- Arrived late for the first show, parking took hours down Wisconsin country roads [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-08-07.141795.sbd.pcm.streeter.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Frank Streeter and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony… [1]
- **gd1982-08-07.165372.mtx.seamons.ht162.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [2]. Also: Rip Tompkins' recording patches a fifteen-second gap between Althea and Let It Grow [2]
- **gd1982-08-07.fob.unknown.suraci.83513.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Matt Field; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nak 300>Sony D5M>Master Cass.>1st Gen [3]. Also: Tape originated from a high school friend's brother at Swarthmore via mid-80s trading [16]
- **gd1982-08-07.138622.beyerm201.holbrook.flac1644**: taped by Executive Crew Kyle Holbrook & Phil Schuman; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac16 44.1khz Set two only. Source Audience Recording: Beyer M 201c Location: 80 feet from stage|DFC (five rows in front of soundboard) [5]. Also: Microphones were positioned in front of the soundboard at Alpine Valley Music Center [5]
- **gd1982-08-07.aud.ohr.92183.flac16**: taped by Ohr Weinberg; transferred by Ohr Weinberg; source: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones (90 degrees, coincident)-> Sony TC-D5M -> 2 Maxell XLII-S 90 Cassettes w/ Dolby B (20th row, center, 8ft stand) [7]
- **gd1982-08-07.156561.s1.beyer.tompkins.flac2448**: taped by Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 04/2022; source: BeyerDynamic mics > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90 [8]. Also: Tape number two from this specific source is missing from the release [8]
